sentences.text:
For the State : Mr. Prabhu Dayal Agrawal, Spl.P.P. : Mrs. Shweta Singh, A.P.P. 05/17.07.2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 assisted by learned A.P.P.
2.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that it is case under Section 498A of the I.P.C. instituted by the opposite party no.2 wife against her husband and other family members and the petitioners in Cr. Revision No. 340 of 2023 happens to be the father-in-law, sister- in-law (gotni)
and brother-in-law (devar) of the opposite party no.2 respectively and the petitioner in Cr. Revision No. 312 of 2023 is the elder brother-in-law (bhaisur) of the opposite party no.2.
The husband of the complainant Gautam Kumar Gupta, who has also been convicted in the instant case has preferred Cr. Revision No. 338 of 2023, which is not on board today.

3. It is jointly submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 that since it is a matrimonial dispute, let one opportunity be given to the parties to explore the possibility of resolving the dispute amicably through the process of mediation.

Learned counsel for the petitioners further submitted that although petitioners have no role to play in the commission of offence, however they would ensure that the husband Gautam Kumar Gupta Bharat Prasad Gupta @ Bharat Gupta vs The State Of Jharkhand on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71365460/
1 shall also participate in the mediation proceeding.

entities.text: Gautam Kumar Gupta Bharat Prasad Gupta @ Bharat Gupta vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. In view of the aforesaid submission, the learned Member Secretary, JHALSA is directed to appoint good mediator to conduct the mediation proceeding effectively and efficiently for resolving the dispute amicably between the parties.
Both the parties along with husband of the opposite party no.2 are directed to remain physically present before the learned Member Secretary, JHALSA on 03.08.2023 at 11.00 a.m.
Learned counsel for both the parties are also directed to ensure the presence of the parties and the husband of the opposite party no.2 in the mediation exercise on the date and time fixed.

Petitioners shall ensure that the husband pays a sum of Rs.2000/- to the opposite party no.2 wife towards travelling and miscellaneous expenses on each date she participates in the mediation proceeding, in presence of the learned Mediator, JHALSA.
5. Let a copy of this order be sent to the Member Secretary, JHALSA to do the needful.
List this case immediately after receipt of the mediation centre report.

6. In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the present petitioners in connection with G.R. Case No. 664 of 2017 arising out of Mihijam P.S. Case No. 99 of 2017 by the court of learned Sub- Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Jamtara.

(Navneet Kumar, J.) A.Mohanty Bharat Prasad Gupta @ Bharat Gupta vs The State Of Jharkhand on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71365460/
